notes.title: Patch notes 0.8.02
notes.content:
[p]Patch notes  0.8.02 - Medieval Darkness DEMO[/p][p]9-18-25[/p][p]Welcome back for another update Strange ones![/p][p]Let's see what the creator has is store for you![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307992/70b516632c34d24c83d7ffbdb3e74bc3517c29aa.png"][/img][/p][p]
Items:[/p][p]-Gems for socketed items are now on boss drop tables. Go get em tiger![/p][p]-The lizardman underground has better loot now![/p][p]Quest:[/p][p]-Removed one of the campfire building options to make Thora’s fire quest less confusing.[/p][p]-Carter Carter will now give a quest to sit at the table next to her… and there is now an icon showing where the table is.  [/p][p]Skills/Spells:[/p][p]The mage Teleport spells now have a working UI![/p][p]UI:[/p][p]-Moved Steam password prompts.[/p][p]-Lock icon on server browsers now showing correctly.[/p][p]
[/p][p]-Mech Monkey Studios Devs[/p][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: -Gems for socketed items are now on boss drop tables. Go get em tiger!
-The lizardman underground has better loot now!

tags.bug: -Removed one of the campfire building options to make Thora’s fire quest less confusing.

tags.feature: - Carter Carter will now give a quest to sit at the table next to her… and there is now an icon showing where the table is.
The mage Teleport spells now have a working UI!

tags.bug: -Lock icon on server browsers now showing correctly.
